note: Replies sent to outreach leads from OUTSIDE the reply desk, so its ledger does not know about them. Written by the outreach session; the desk owns data/reply-desk.json and this file deliberately does not touch it.
why_this_file_exists: The desk records what the DESK sent, not what the lead received. Six leads were answered by hand from the Instantly inbox on 2026-10-16 and still read 'drafted' days later; these three are the same situation created by this session. Marking them sent is the desk operator's call, not ours.
double_send_risk: Low, and not the reason for this file. The desk re-reads each thread before sending and refuses when anything outbound postdates the lead's reply -- that guard is what refused the 2026-10-16 six when this session tried to answer them. All three threads below now carry an outbound after the lead's reply, so the desk will refuse them too. This file is about the ledger being accurate, not about averting a send.
